# Noah Crowley Asbestos and Designated Substances Consulting

> Noah Crowley Consulting is an independent asbestos and designated substances consultancy based in Windsor, Ontario, serving Windsor-Essex, Chatham-Kent, Sarnia-Lambton and London. It surveys buildings, keeps O. Reg. 278/05 asbestos records, writes abatement specifications, oversees abatement, tests the air and does Type 3 clearance. It never removes asbestos and takes no referral fees.

- Clients: commercial and institutional building owners, landlords and condos, general and restoration contractors.
- Reports cover all 11 Ontario designated substances and are priced as a report fee plus samples taken. Prices are CAD before HST.
- Lab results take 5 business days from the lab's receipt. Rush analysis is not offered.
- Contact: 519-890-9654, info@crowleyconsulting.ca, https://crowleyconsulting.ca/contact.html

## Reports (starting prices)
- Limited sampling visit: from $650. One to three suspect materials before a small repair: one floor, one pipe run, one wall. About 7 business days.
- DSS update or re-assessment: from $550. An existing report that is out of date, or another firm's report that fell short. 5 business days; 8–10 with sampling.
- Project-specific DSS: from $1,500. Renovation, repair or a tender for one work area. 8–10 business days.
- Asbestos building survey: from $1,800. No survey on file for the building, or the start of a building program. 10–15 business days.
- Full-building DSS and hazardous materials survey: from $2,400. Acquisition, capital planning, several projects in one building. 10–20 business days.
- Pre-demolition DSS: from $3,900. A vacant building coming down, or a demolition permit. 15–25 business days.

## Programs (monthly, per building)
- Building programs, Compliance Essentials: from $69 a month. Owners who need the yearly record kept current.
- Building programs, Project Ready: from $149 a month. Buildings where contractors are working several times a year.
- Building programs, Facility Partner: from $529 a month. Three or more buildings, or a board or JHSC asking questions.
- Cleared-to-Start Pass, Starter: from $199 a month. Renovators and trades with 1–3 jobs a month in older buildings.
- Cleared-to-Start Pass, Pro: from $499 a month. General contractors and fit-out firms with 4 or more jobs a month.
- Cleared-to-Start Pass, Restoration Priority: from $699 a month. Fire, flood and mould restoration firms, for the rebuild phase of a claim.
